subject: Fluid Mechanics 101 guidance applied to the low-y+ mesh family

sources.use: First full cell height = 2 * wall-to-centroid distance; correct first height with measured y+; cover boundary layer and transition smoothly to outer mesh.
Generic wall-function discussion recommends y+<5 or y+>30, avoiding buffer region. This is not a universal SST-specific y+=1 rule.
STAR All-y+ guidance: below 1 or above 30; low-y+ target below 1.

analytical_estimate.mu_status: Assumption for analytical estimate, not verified from the saved material definition
analytical_estimate.method: Re=rho*U*L/mu; Cf=(2log10(Re)-0.65)^-2.3; ut=U sqrt(Cf/2); h1=2 mu/(rho ut); delta99=0.38 L/Re^0.2. Fully turbulent flat-plate estimate, not foil validation.

interpretation.target: Retain y+ below 1 over the resolved wall for the low-y+ family; do not switch to wall functions merely to make the maximum acceptable.
interpretation.first_height: M04 measured frozen-shear correction suggests about 2.55 um for p95 y+=1; M06 gives 2.53 um. Current M06 2.142857 um has useful margin.
interpretation.growth_caveat: Growth values solve a geometric series from nominal h1, N and T. They are equivalent design ratios, not independently verified local STAR stretching ratios.
interpretation.total_caveat: 15.46 mm matches the assumed-viscosity flat-plate delta99 estimate. Check upper/lower foil velocity profiles, pressure gradients and prism-to-core transition before final selection.
interpretation.trailing_edge: M06 has 99.770152% wall area y+<1, but max252.4436 at x/c0.999404 with only one continuous quad layer. Local topology/spacing must be reviewed and repaired without altering foil geometry; global first-height reduction alone does not fix layer collapse.
interpretation.causality: M04 to M06 changes wall-normal, tangential and outer refinement together. CD/CL differences cannot be attributed uniquely to y+.
interpretation.source_math_check: For fixed h1 and N, total T increases with r. Use the explicit coverage condition T>=delta99; do not blindly follow wording that smaller r necessarily improves coverage.
interpretation.next: Let existing M07 finish. Compare final windows within family. No new mesh admitted or simulation altered by this design review; preserve M08–M10 for targeted checks. At least two finer confirmations per current plan.
